text:
jin: Quick question — where's the best place to look for per-pool KV-cache hit rate + tail latency for dedicated pools? specifically looking at dedicated-eu-8 because autoscale has been noisy.

marta: Grafana -> Inference / Dedicated Pools / Pool Overview. there's a panel for `kv_cache.hit_rate` and p99 latency. quick link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/inf-dedicated/pool-overview?orgId=1&var-pool=dedicated-eu-8

samir: FWIW p99 can be spikey if warm-up is happening. What window are you using for alerts?

jin: Currently we have an alert firing on `kv_cache.hit_rate < 0.6 for 10m` which seems aggressive during scheduled drains. Thinking to add `and on_call != "drain"` is not possible — so maybe increase threshold or add suppression for planned drains.

marta: Agreed. Two options: 1) widen the window to 30m + require sustained tail-latency increase; or 2) add silence during maintenance via the maintenance API. For (1) sample promql:

```promql
avg_over_time(kv_cache_hit_rate{pool="dedicated-eu-8"}[30m]) < 0.65
and
avg_over_time(request_latency_p99_ms{pool="dedicated-eu-8"}[30m]) > 120
```

That avoids one-off cold-start blips.

jin: Nice — can you drop that query into a patch to the dedicated-pools alerting dashboard? I'll review.

samir: Ping me for review too. I want to make sure we don't mask real saturation. Maybe we should correlate with `pool_cpu_utilization` and `inflight_requests` before muting alerts.

marta: good point. will include `and pool_cpu_utilization > 0.7` in the firing rule.

observability-bot: Dashboard deploy succeeded for `alerts/dedicated-pools` by marta (PR #412). CI: ✅, lint: ✅

oliver: quick note — dedicated-eu-8 is a canary config (smaller instance types), its saturation curve is steeper. We should keep a lower threshold on canaries so we get notified earlier. maybe keep canary threshold at 0.6 and prod at 0.75.

kat: +1 on separate thresholds. Also for debugging logs, per-pool inference logs are in s3: s3://redwood-logs/dedicated/eu-8/YYYY/MM/DD/*.gz. Use `zcat | jq` for quick searches.

jin: Thanks all. Plan: marta to land PR with 30m window + cpu check + canary-specific threshold. samir & i will review. I'll also add a note in the incident runbook about maintenance silences.

marta: PR up in ~15m, will @samir @jin for review.

samir: I'll take first pass.

oliver: If you want, I can run a dashboard quick smoke test against the historical traffic from last week to validate no regressions.

jin: That would be helpful — thanks.

marta: test run queued. will post results here.

observability-bot: Manual smoke test completed: 2026-03-17 15:12Z. No alert regressions on staging.

kat: small UX ask — can we add a tiny legend to the panel explaining `kv_cache_hit_rate` calc (hits / (hits+misses))? New folks keep misreading it.

marta: good call, will add panel description and a hover tooltip.

jin: perfect. after PR + tests i'll merge. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
